issues.description: The chunking prompt (F.15) specifies a hard numeric limit 'max 250 words each' for context chunks. This is a non‑trivial numeric recommendation and is not supported by any of the provided retrieved excerpts or context memory. The document elsewhere (RAG PoC) only advises configuring max chunks/tokens according to the chosen embeddings service but does not prescribe '250 words'.
issues.required_fix: Remove the hard 'max 250 words' value or qualify it as an editable example. Replace with a guidance statement such as: 'Choose a maximum chunk size appropriate for your embeddings/tokens limits (set according to your embeddings service; e.g., configure token/word limits per provider).' Ensure the prompt asks the model to respect a caller‑supplied max size parameter rather than hardcoding 250 words.

issues.description: The LaTeX body uses non‑ASCII Czech characters and verbatim blocks. The section does not state LaTeX preamble requirements (input encoding, packages) which may cause compilation issues in some toolchains.
issues.required_fix: Add a short editor note or comment in the preface/preamble stating required LaTeX settings, e.g. include \usepackage[utf8]{inputenc} (or use XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX) and ensure the verbatim environment is available (package 'verbatim' is standard).

issues.description: Several templates that produce machine‑readable outputs (e.g., MCQ JSON in B.4, chunker output in F.15) do not include concrete example output/format examples. Users may be uncertain about field naming, types, and encoding expectations.
issues.required_fix: Add one short example for each machine‑oriented template showing a minimal valid output (e.g., a single MCQ JSON object and a single chunk JSON object). This improves immediate usability and reduces errors when importing into LMS/embedding pipelines.

issues.description: Prompts for assessment and automated feedback (e.g., B.3 MCQ bank, C.7 feedback assistant, C.8 code review) do not consistently instruct inclusion of a human‑in‑the‑loop validation step or explicit caution about relying solely on generated outputs for grading.
issues.required_fix: Add a short line in relevant templates reminding the teacher: 'Validate generated items/feedback manually before publishing/using for grading; use human review to check correctness, bias, and appropriateness.' This aligns with governance and human‑in‑the‑loop guidance in the main document.

issues.description: The chunking prompt asks for '2 keypoints' and a '1‑sentence summary suitable as an embedding description' — consider clarifying length limits for the embedding description (e.g., max tokens/characters) and whether the summary should be purely descriptive or include metadata.
issues.required_fix: Clarify within the chunking prompt that the 1‑sentence embedding description should be concise (e.g., 20–40 words or ~128 tokens) and purely descriptive (no formatting or citations). Alternatively, make the length configurable by the caller.

suggested_edits.target: F.15 Chunking interního dokumentu pro RAG (latex_body)
suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Remove 'max 250 words each' from the verbatim prompt and replace with: 'split it into context chunks respecting a caller‑supplied max size (set according to your embeddings/tokens limits). For example: max_chunk_tokens=500.' Also add a short example output showing one chunk JSON with fields: chunk_id, title, keypoints[], summary (one sentence).

Insert an editor note in the appendix or at the start of the Prompt Library: 'LaTeX notes: ensure source encoding is UTF‑8 (\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc} for pdflatex or compile with XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX). Verbatim environments require the standard 'verbatim' package.'
Add a one‑item example JSON object (single MCQ) after the prompt showing id, question, options[], correct_index, explanation, difficulty to illustrate exact field names and types.
Add the sentence 'Teacher: always perform a manual review and validation of generated feedback/questions/solutions before using them for grading' to each assessment/feedback template.
Clarify the expected length for the '1‑sentence summary suitable as an embedding description' (e.g., 'concise, 10–30 words'). Make this adjustable via a parameter in the prompt.
